newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 102.083.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.002pts to 102.083.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.002 points in Tuesday's trading to 102.083, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.470 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 98.556 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.341 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.079 points to 1,093.476.
